hostname rt-g02
!
service timestamps log datetime
!
username admin privilege 15 secret 0 dummy-admin-secret-1
!
class-map match-any cm-g-voice
 match cos 5
 match qos-group 10
!
policy-map pm-g-in
 class cm-g-voice
  set qos-group 10
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0
 description sample uplink port
 ip address 203.0.113.69 255.255.255.252
 ip mtu 1454
 ip tcp adjust-mss 1414
 no shutdown
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/1
 description sample-lan
 ip address 198.51.100.1 255.255.255.0
 service-policy input pm-g-in
 no shutdown
!
interface Loopback0
 ip address 192.0.2.1 255.255.255.255
 no shutdown
!
logging buffered 131072 warnings
!
logging facility local0
logging source-interface Loopback0
logging host 192.0.2.50
!
ntp server 192.0.2.123
!
end
